Whisky Preview

A development fork of frankea/Whisky, itself a fork of the archived whisky-app/whisky. It carries work that hasn't been merged upstream yet, so it is less settled than either.

Install

brew tap dappermint/tap
brew trust --cask dappermint/tap/whisky-preview
brew install --cask whisky-preview

The brew trust step is required: Homebrew refuses casks from third-party taps until trusted, because a cask can run code on install. This one does. Requires macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later. The app is self-signed and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks a plain double-click of the DMG with no way to approve it; the cask clears the quarantine flag so it launches.

What's different

  • DLL overrides written to the registry per executable, so a launcher and the games it starts can use different graphics backends
  • Launchers default to DXVK when a GPTK runtime is installed
  • The managed override list follows the selected backend instead of drifting from it
  • Cheaper process polling while waiting for a cold Steam client
  • Its own Wine runtime stream built from CrossOver 25 sources with GStreamer and FFmpeg

Coexisting with Whisky

Whisky Preview uses its own bundle identifier, so it installs beside an existing Whisky rather than replacing it, and starts with no bottles. File → Import Bottles from Another Whisky… adopts bottles from either earlier build. Bottles are referenced in place, never copied or moved, so the other build keeps working.

Updates

There is no in-app updater. Upgrades come through Homebrew:

brew upgrade --cask whisky-preview

GPL-3.0, like Whisky. Source at dappermint/Whisky (preview branch) · WhiskyKit documentation

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Whisky project. Please report problems with this build to this fork's issue tracker, not upstream.
